records.title: 高空減圧症（altitude decompression sickness）の治療経験
records.locator: Vol. 35, no. 2, p. 115, abstract 30, right column
records.note: Cases were selected for treatment. A denominator, event date, case-level external linkage and delayed follow-up are unavailable.

observations.locator: Vol. 35, no. 2, p. 115, abstract 30, right column, case 1
observations.note: Case 1, a 37-year-old F-16 pilot, reportedly reached 28,000 ft in two seconds on the first of three flights. The abstract gives no pressure trace or reference altitude for that transition. Headache began after the return to Kadena and low back pain followed. Headache resolved during initial recompression.

observations.locator: Vol. 35, no. 2, p. 115, abstract 30, right column, case 2
observations.note: Case 2, a 31-year-old man taking part in A-10 training at Osan, developed right ulnar forearm and left leg numbness approximately one hour after return, then right elbow and left knee pain 30 minutes later. He presented to the University of the Ryukyus eight hours after symptom onset. Symptoms resolved during reported recompression.
